compiled_state.title: As a bridge operator, I want the create path to search Jira by dso-id label before creating, so that the bridge never generates a duplicate for an already-mapped local ticket.
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
Dedup-aware outbound create. Before any Jira create REST call, applier searches via JQL 'labels = "dso-id:<uuid>"'. On hit, reuses existing key. On miss, proceeds with create.

## Done Definitions
- Outbound create attempts execute JQL 'labels = "dso-id:<uuid>"' search before the create REST call ← Satisfies: sc-3
- When JQL returns a match, applier writes existing jira-key to mapping.json, skips create, emits 'dedup-create-skipped' event ← Satisfies: sc-3
- Test harness with pre-existing dso-id-labeled Jira issue runs one reconciler pass and produces zero new Jira issues with the same dso-id ← Satisfies: sc-3

## Considerations
- [Performance] Per-pass REST call budget (200 default) — defer remaining creates if budget would be exceeded rather than skipping the search.

## Escalation Policy
Escalate when blocked
